name: 01913 · Amesbury, MA
findings: ZIP 01913 (Amesbury) has 68 nonprofit organizations. 23 of them (34%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 18 organizations.
Arts and cultural organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (27% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 01913 (Amesbury) has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.
